title: PredefinedConfigurationMetadata
description: Schema for MEDIATE Message M3. This message provides predefined configuration library metadata from the Predefined Configuration Libraries to the Overwatch Broker and then to the DSS.

type.description: NGSI-LD entity type. It has to be predefinedConfigurationMetadata.

deploymentUnitId.description: Property. Identifier of the Sentinel Reconfiguration Deployment Unit.

source.description: Property. Source component or library providing the predefined configuration metadata.

timestamp.description: Property. Date and time at which the predefined configuration metadata message was generated.

request.description: Property. Request-related information associated with the predefined configuration metadata.

contentId.description: Identifier of the requested or updated content.

contentType.description: Content type included in the predefined configuration metadata request context.

targetDSS.description: Relationship. DSS component intended to consume the predefined configuration metadata.

trigger.description: Information describing what triggered the metadata message.

triggerType.description: Type of trigger that caused the metadata update.

contentId.description: Identifier of the content related to the trigger.

configurationPayload.description: Property. Payload containing the predefined configuration metadata.

version.description: Version of the predefined configuration payload.

description.description: List of predefined configuration metadata entries.

name.description: Name of the predefined configuration entry.

action.description: Action associated with the predefined configuration entry.

key.description: Key or reference associated with the predefined configuration entry.

integrity.description: Property. Integrity information used to verify the configuration payload.

checksum.description: Checksum value of the configuration payload.

signature.description: Signature associated with the configuration payload.

status.description: Property. Status of the configuration metadata retrieval and validation.

state.description: Current state of the metadata retrieval process.

validated.description: Indicates whether the configuration payload has been validated.

validationMethod.description: Method used to validate the configuration payload.
